text: 宽基ETF本周被大举买入。Wind数据显示，ETF本周净流入2290.83亿元，宽基ETF贡献最多净流入额，流入1561.28亿元。其中，沪深300、中证1000、科创50的挂钩ETF本周合计净流入额居首，分别为399.84亿元、256.28亿元、196.19亿元。单只产品来看，沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞净流入最多，为214.46亿元，最新规模为995.21亿元，即将重回千亿以上；其次是中证1000ETF南方，净流入139.99亿元；中证500ETF南方也净流入113.68亿元；净流入超百亿的还有创业板ETF易方达、科创50ETF华夏。
text_en: Broad-based ETFs saw heavy buying this week. Wind data shows that ETFs recorded net inflows of 229.083 billion yuan this week, with broad-based ETFs contributing the most, at 156.128 billion yuan. Among them, ETFs tracking the CSI 300, CSI 1000, and STAR 50 had the highest total net inflows this week, at 39.984 billion yuan, 25.628 billion yuan, and 19.619 billion yuan, respectively. Looking at individual products, the CSI 300 ETF from Huatai-PineBridge had the highest net inflow, at 21.446 billion yuan, with the latest scale reaching 99.521 billion yuan, set to return above the 100 billion yuan mark; followed by the CSI 1000 ETF from China Southern, with net inflows of 13.999 billion yuan; the CSI 500 ETF from China Southern also had net inflows of 11.368 billion yuan; other ETFs with net inflows exceeding 10 billion yuan included the ChiNext ETF from E Fund and the STAR 50 ETF from China Asset Management.
